text:
Tara: Pushed a short relnotes draft for the KV/prefix cache + batching tweaks and the Dedicated canary UI. Need a quick pass on snippets (py/js), a Private migration blurb, and the Known Issues list before we lock.

Ben: Drop the draft link pls

Tara: https://docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/draft-kvcache-2026 (WIP)

Kai: I'll take snippets. Which SDK style should we prefer in the examples? v1?

Tara: Default to v1. Add a tiny callout for v0.9 compatibility. Keep examples minimal.

Yara: Known issue to call out: customers using 4-bit quantized runtimes may see rare tokenization offsets on long tails. Add mitigation suggestions (re-tokenize, use full-precision for sensitive evals) and link to the eval artifacts.

Ben: For Private customers we need a migration checklist: config key rename (`kv_cache.enabled` -> `cache.kv_enabled`), helm override sample, and a warmup curl to prime KV after rolling update. I'll draft those.

Kai: Draft Python snippet (v1):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.generate(
    model="redwood-optim-1",
    input="Summarize the changes",
    options={"cache": {"kv_enabled": True}, "batch": {"max_tokens": 512}},
)
print(resp.text)
```
I'll add JS mirror.

Yara: Small editorial note: avoid publishing exact percent savings in the public relnote — keep it qualitative unless marketing signs off. I'll add a neutral blurb: "measurable per-route latency and cost improvements".

Tara: Good — mark any internal bench numbers as internal-only. Also add a one-liner "opt out" for operators: `cache.kv_enabled=false` in deployment spec.

Ben: Warmup curl snippet for Private customers (draft):
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-infer.example/api/warmup -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-optim-1","variant":"pinned"}'
```
We'll refine with ops for exact endpoint.

Kai: Quick lint nit: show the options shape in a comment so readers know where to set `cache` vs top-level.

lint-bot: Snippet linter queued. Please run linkcheck after edits.

Tara: docs-bot: please schedule a dry-run with snippet-lint and linkcheck tomorrow 2026-03-24T18:30:00Z.

docs-bot: Scheduled dry-run at 2026-03-24T18:30:00Z. Snippet linter and linkcheck queued.

Yara: One more Known Issue: Private + pinned variants might see prefix cache misses after worker restarts. Workaround: run the warmup job above or a short rolling restart pattern to prime shards. Add a short command example for kubectl.

Ben: I'll add the helm override and kubectl one-liner: `kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/inference-worker` as an immediate mitigation.

Kai: After linter results I'll push the JS snippet and mark examples ready. If the linter flags deprecated args, include a tiny migration note.

Tara: Aim to merge after green dry-run. If anything blocks, tag @Tara or @Ben. Thanks all :thumbsup:
